newsitem.title: USA: D&P leaves Fisher Scientific on watch.
newsitem.headline: D&P leaves Fisher Scientific on watch.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Friday it is maintaining a rating watch-down status for Fisher Scientific International Inc's senior unsecured debt.

D&P said it expects Fisher's proposed $1.4 billion recapitalization transaction with Thomas H. Lee Co will include a significant increase in existing debt and will likely lead to a rating downgrade. Neither Fisher nor Thomas H. Lee have disclosed details of financing for the proposed transaction, D&P noted in a news release.
D&P said it rates Fisher's unsecured debt triple-B. The rating watch affects about $150 million of debt securities.
Shares of Fisher were trading off 1/4 to 49-1/4.
